incident.name: Stuxnet
incident.description: First known cyberweapon targeting industrial control systems. Sabotaged Iranian nuclear centrifuges via Siemens PLCs.
incident.lessons: ICS/OT networks require air-gapping and strict supply chain controls.

relatedIncidents.name: Colonial Pipeline Ransomware
relatedIncidents.description: DarkSide ransomware shut down largest US fuel pipeline for 6 days. $4.4M ransom paid. Fuel shortages across US East Coast.
relatedIncidents.lessons: MFA on all remote access is mandatory. OT/IT network separation critical.
